env.//: Allows the investigator roles (researcher, test-writer) to spawn their own helper subagents for parallel legwork. Project-scoped on purpose (not ~/.claude) so the blast radius stays in this repo. Depth 2 = Arbiter -> investigator -> helper. Only agents with `Agent` in their tools: line can actually spawn; devil/verifier/angel deliberately omit it. See CLAUDE.md 'Nested spawning'.
env.//models: Point the opus/sonnet aliases at the 4.x generation: Opus 4.8 for the Arbiter, Sonnet 4.6 for the cross-model checks. Both verified served on this gateway (2026-07-29): claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-4-6 each return 200 and echo back that exact id. NOTE there is no Sonnet 4.8 -- claude-sonnet-4-8 400s; Sonnet's line runs 4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 5, so 4.6 is the newest pre-5 Sonnet and the correct counterpart to Opus 4.8. The cross-model roles pin claude-sonnet-4-6 explicitly in their agent files; these defaults cover any remaining bare-alias use and make new sessions default to Opus 4.8. Loaded at session start -- run `/model claude-opus-4-8` to switch THIS session's arbiter (angel follows via `inherit`).
